items.text: Dear Bytelanders,
We're excited to bring you this fresh update to enhance your overclocked adventures in Byteland! Here’s a summary of what’s new and tweaked:
Split Screen Support: Enjoy Boti with friends on the same screen! Now supporting both keyboard and gamepad inputs for a split-screen experience.
FOV Slider: Tailor your field of view to your liking with the new FOV change option.
Soundful Emote Wheel: Express yourself with style and sound using the updated Emote Wheel.
Character Commentary: Reduced chatter from Zero and One for a more focused gameplay experience.
Music Management: The game's music will now take a backseat while you're indulging in Kernel's memories.
Portals Sound: Patched up all portal sound inconsistencies for a smoother auditory journey.
Interaction Icons: Fixed the interaction icons at level 5 for a more intuitive interface.
Resource Display: Now, the required amount of files or coins for upgrading the HUB or uploading points will be accurately displayed to the players.
Deathtopus Sounds: Various fixes to Deathtopus sounds to ensure they are as terrifying as intended.
Engine Update: Leveled up to version 5.3 of the engine for better performance and smoother gameplay.
Thanks for your continuous support and feedback. Your adventures in Byteland help us fine-tune and expand the Boti universe. Stay overclocked!
